purpose: Gap-test for the pull path: does a fresh agent, given only a task-like question and no hint that memory exists, reach knowledge that lives ONLY in ai-mem? Stage A runs agents (see README.md); stage B (replay.py) replays the queries those agents wrote against cosine/hybrid.
method_source: Gap-test method: knowledge lives only in memory; ask a fresh agent without a hint; compare a memory arm against a no-memory arm (see README.md)
validity_rules: Knowledge exists only in memory (checked: repo files, git log messages+diffs, project instructions, auto-memory)
Answer is not derivable from common sense
A wrong first instinct exists, so a bad answer is visible
Question must not reuse the answer's vocabulary (questions were written after reading the entries, so this is minimised, not eliminated)

scoring.ok: Correct answer, ai-mem entry cited or its non-derivable facts present -> works
scoring.neutral: Correct answer reconstructed from code/docs/git without the discriminator facts -> no gap, weak case
scoring.fail: Wrong or generic answer -> memory did not help
scoring.neighbour: Accurate, well-sourced answer to an adjacent question, no incompleteness signal -> partial fail (hardest to spot)
scoring.control_ok: Control: agent says it is not documented/unknown
scoring.control_fail: Control: agent fabricates or answers confidently from adjacent material

cases.question: Warum wirft ai-mem mir nichts mehr in den Kontext, bevor ich eine Datei bearbeite? Früher war das mal anders. Was hat die Entscheidung ausgelöst?
cases.wrong_instinct: Generic 'token cost scaled with edits' (docs/hooks.md says roughly that) or 'it was buggy/slow'
cases.discriminator: Trigger was a usage scan by another session over 50 transcripts: 348 Edit/Write calls ~ 67.6k tokens ~ 92% of ai-mem's whole context footprint; the maintainer then chose a full switch to pull

cases.question: Woher kommt eigentlich die Idee hinter ai-mem, dass es aus Nutzungsverhalten lernt statt mit einem fertigen Modell zu arbeiten?
cases.wrong_instinct: Rationalisation from code/docs: 'simplicity, no training step, no torch dependency'
cases.discriminator: Origin (2026-04-25): a conversation about NPUs, sensor fusion and local on-device ML; sensor data -> frequency space -> micro-model learning from actual states without labels/cloud/pretrained model; Bayesian bandit + CUSUM; 'no cloud upload' philosophy

cases.question: In der Git-Historie sieht man, dass mem_dream mal nur mit 'exit status 1' abgebrochen ist. Was war damals die Ursache, und was hat man geändert?
cases.wrong_instinct: 'The pinned claude-sonnet-4-6 tag was stale, so the CLI rejected it' (the diff invites exactly this reading)
cases.discriminator: The stale versioned tag was NOT proven to be the trigger: a manual repro with the old tag still exited 0. The real diagnostic blocker was check=True hiding stderr (CalledProcessError str() has only the exit code). Fix: bare aliases + RuntimeError carrying stderr/stdout

cases.question: Was war der eigentliche Auslöser dafür, dass der UserPromptSubmit-Hook am 13. September entfernt wurde?
cases.wrong_instinct: CLAUDE.md says both push hooks were retired after token-cost/noise measurements -> answer 'cost'
cases.discriminator: Trigger was the maintainer noticing that an attempted deactivation of ai-mem auto-inject had no effect; an audit of all settings layers found none where ai-mem was actually disabled, and the hooks kept firing

cases.question: Ich bin mit einer größeren Änderung fertig und die Tests laufen durch. Soll ich vor dem Commit noch etwas einplanen, oder ist das dann gut?
cases.wrong_instinct: 'Tests green -> commit' (project instructions only ask for a test run)
cases.discriminator: The maintainer rates code-review runs as worthwhile for stability/security; run one after non-trivial work before committing (a past run found 8 verified findings, incl. a bug in the fix itself)

cases.question: Ich will für die nächste Session festhalten, woran ich gerade arbeite und wo wir stehen. Wie formuliere ich das am besten?
cases.wrong_instinct: Write explicit status words ('in progress', 'not committed yet')
cases.discriminator: Never embed mutable status strings in entry text; reference commit SHA / ticket id and update when it exists. Evidence: three entries from 2026-07-31 had stale 'NOT YET COMMITTED' markers within the same session

cases.question: Welche Inferenz-Latenz hat ai-mem auf einem Smartphone gemessen?
cases.expected: Not documented anywhere. The origin entry mentions a phone only as the idea's origin, no measurements. Tests the 'neighbour' failure: confident answer from adjacent material.

cases.question: Wann wurde entschieden, ai-mem als PyPI-Paket zu veröffentlichen, und warum?
